# C# . PROG6212

Free focused revision pack. Suggested time: 45 minutes.

Object lifetime, LINQ, APIs, data access and MVVM.

Attempt every question before opening the answers. These are supplementary exercises, not a complete syllabus or an official exam.

## Question 1

Build a console program that prints the passing marks in [40, 75, 50]. Predict the output.

## Question 2

Why should a file stream be disposed? Show the pattern.

## Question 3

Plan CRUD endpoints for a Student API. Include status codes.

## Question 4

An EF Core update changes a tracked student name. What saves it?

## Question 5

In WPF MVVM, why does changing a property sometimes not update the screen?
